messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service 'prod-autoscaler' — Condition: queue_length > 500 for 3m. Severity: P1. Alert ID: PD-98123.

pagerduty-bot: Triggered on: prod-autoscaler. Auto-escalation enabled. Paging primary on-call.

ben_dev: oncall here — seeing the PD page, jumping in. Can someone paste recent queue metrics?

carla_sre: acked on PD, i'm on incident. quick summary from prometheus: queue_length = ~1.2k, 5m avg latency = 28s, error rate (5m) = 3.8%. GPU pool utilization = 98% in us-west-2.

ben_dev: running quick checks — hpa and replica status:
```
$ kubectl get hpa -n inference
NAME            REFERENCE                TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
autoscaler      Deployment/autoscaler    85%/90%   10        40        10
$ kubectl get deploy inference-srv -n inference -o jsonpath='{.status}'
replicas: 10
availableReplicas: 9
conditions: [ScaleUpFailed: insufficient resources]
```

carla_sre: looks like HPA tried to scale but failed due to resource constraints (nodes saturated). cloud provider shows no spare GPU capacity in the pool. autoscaler policy has max 40 which we haven't reached but scheduler can't place pods.

deepa_ml: confirming model serving queues — pending_requests per shard: [220, 310, 180, 150, 340] (total ~1200). KV-cache hit rates ok, so this is pure capacity.

frank_ops: i'm pulling provider console — all reserved dedicated GPU nodes are at 100%. There's also an ongoing maintenance in us-west that reduced free nodes by 2. Trying to request burst capacity now (req id: BC-774).

ben_dev: attempted a manual scale to 25 replicas: `kubectl scale deploy inference-srv --replicas=25 -n inference` -> pods stuck in Pending with reason: "Insufficient GPU".

carla_sre: mitigations to try now: 1) enable fallback to lower-ram quantized model for non-critical routes, 2) throttle batch size on new requests, 3) route new traffic to eu-west where spare capacity exists, 4) request emergency capacity from cloud (frank is on it). Who can rotate traffic?

alice_k: I can flip the routing rule for the /assistant-west endpoint to eu-west for 20% of traffic. Will do canary first (5%).

deepa_ml: I'll deploy a smaller model variant behind '/assistant-fallback' for low-priority requests; patch config now. This should drop per-request GPU memory ~40% and reduce queue pressure.

frank_ops: cloud support confirmed they can add 6 g4dn nodes in ~12 minutes but need approval. I've submitted emergency capacity request and pinged infra lead.

pagerduty-bot: PD escalation to secondary after 5m (if not acknowledged). Currently acknowledged by carla_sre.

carla_sre: manual safety throttle applied: `gateway.rate_limit('inference', 200rps)` — dropping non-essential traffic and returning 429 for low-priority bulk jobs.

ben_dev: adding logs — from autoscaler controller: `ScaleUp rejected: insufficient quota` and scheduler: `0/30 nodes are available: 30 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu`. So autoscaler was healthy but cluster lacks capacity to satisfy it.

alice_k: can confirm canary routing at 5% succeeded — eu-west accepted traffic, latency there ~120ms. I'm increasing to 25% now.

deepa_ml: fallback model rollout started — 3 pods up, handling low-priority queues. Pending reduced from ~1200 -> ~780 in 4m.

frank_ops: cloud confirmed they started provisioning extra nodes (BC-774 accepted). ETA 9m.

ben_dev: relevant support ticket for customer-facing issues: SUP-4721 created, CS notified. Noting customers on Dedicated with tight SLAs may see 20-40s increased latency and some 504s.

carla_sre: summary of current status: - queue_length ~780 (down from 1.2k) - effective replicas 13 (10 -> 13 via fallback) - autoscaler still cannot place pods until new nodes come up - eu-west routing offloads ~25% of traffic - emergency capacity pending ETA 9m - PD incident remains P1.

ben_dev: timeline + actions recorded for handoff. If nodes are not ready in 12m we escalate to oncall manager and we may trigger emergency preemption of low-priority Dedicated jobs.

alice_k: notifying support channel and posting status to #general-customer-warnings : "Partial degradation of inference in us-west; routing to eu-west + fallback models in effect."

carla_sre: frank, can you get estimated time once nodes register? I want to start handoff at 04:30Z if still active.

frank_ops: will update. New nodes registered in k8s at 1749345825, kubelet ready. Now scheduler can place pods.

ben_dev: seeing pods start to schedule and become Running. replicas -> 22 within 3m. queue dropping to ~200.

deepa_ml: fallback model scale can be reversed gradually. I'll keep it until queue <100 and latency stable.

carla_sre: PD note: incident acknowledged and being actively mitigated. I've left a short incident summary to PD: "Autoscaler bottleneck in us-west due to provider capacity exhaustion + maintenance; routing/fallback applied, emergency capacity added; ongoing verification."

pagerduty-bot: PD incident INC-2026-401 created and linked to PD-98123. Acknowledged by carla_sre.

ben_dev: handoff: carla_sre -> frank_ops for next-hour oncall; frank will own monitoring until cleared. I will draft incident timeline and assign postmortem to myself + deepa_ml.

frank_ops: taking over. I'll keep shoulder open for customer-impact follow ups and confirm rollback plan.

carla_sre: final notes before handoff: - file postmortem ticket PM-318 with initial suspects (autoscaler config + capacity reservation during maintenance). - collect HPA events, scheduler logs, cloud capacity logs (BC-774). - mitigation steps that worked: route to eu-west, fallback models, emergency capacity.

ben_dev: quick checklist saved to runbook: `/runbooks/autoscaler-capacity` — we'll update with node-failure playbook.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for active ownership transition. Please update PD and postmortem links in this thread once available. :thumbsup:

frank_ops: confirmed — leaving monitoring hooks for 30m, will comment if anything regresses.

carla_sre: thanks team — great triage and fast mitigations. Assigning postmortem ownership to ben_dev.

ben_dev: will start war-room notes and upload logs. Closing active paging.

frank_ops: last metric check at 1749345889: queue_length 88, 5m avg latency 2.1s, error rate 0.2%. All looks stable.

carla_sre: last message from me before fully handing off: create PM and link PD incident. I'll join the postmortem.

ben_dev: noted. END OF THREAD.
